hook: In October 2026, AI providers triggered 201 total price changes.

sections.voiceover: In October 2026, AI providers triggered 201 total price changes.

sections.visual_cue: A split screen showing a downward red arrow for cuts and an upward green arrow for hikes.

sections.voiceover: That 90 percent discount beats the 89 percent price drop for the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model.
sections.visual_cue: A bar chart showing the 89 percent drop for the specified model.
b_roll: Animated bar chart showing rapid decline

sections.voiceover: Mistral AI also slashed Mistral Large 4 input costs to 0.7 dollars per million tokens.

sections.voiceover: Mistral AI also set the Mistral Large 4 output price at 2.10 dollars per million tokens.
